new_stop_tests: Both failed before the implementation, then passed; provider blocks stop the whole scheduled condition and resuming it dispatches no further requests.
new_privacy_canary: A canary under review-v2 failed detection before the extension and is detected after it.
condition_collector: Three CLI integration tests failed before implementation and passed afterward: missing runs retain blank measurements, unlisted previous-condition profiles are excluded, and live partial reports are not exported as complete.
new_namespace_tests: Both failed before the shim existed and passed afterward; cache names are distinct from the earlier condition and arguments/limits are preserved.
new_count_normalization_tests: Both failed before the functional-mode parameter existed and passed afterward; overall counts are logged while numeric defect evidence and fenced probes are preserved.
new_verification_redaction_test: Failed before the new mode existed, then passed; functional-mode redaction preserves numeric regression evidence in verification sections while hiding tool markers, with every edit logged.
condition_output_isolation_tests: Both CLI tests failed before the new options existed and passed afterward in copied temporary harnesses: rechecks preserve the prior study file; appended rows preserve prior YAML bytes and link condition-specific reports, scores and eligible bug IDs.
nested_finding_label_test: Both heading/number/bold combinations failed before the fix and passed afterward; all19 residual numbered pilot headings normalize afterward, while numeric regression evidence and fenced probes survive. Default historical mode is unchanged.
coverage_footer_preservation_test: Failed before the functional-mode fix, then passed. A real completed-report footer disclosed environment-blocked doctests and unrun checks; the legacy whole-footer drop would have erased it. Functional mode now preserves it while normalizing the count; default historical mode is unchanged.
